title: Continuity status store and Nostr read-model projector

criteria.statement: The service package exposes an in-memory, RWMutex-protected continuity status store keyed by ServiceKey with update, single-service, DNS-facing, and list-all query methods.
Continuity runtime status events update the store and publish kind 30351 continuity-status read models with d=continuity-status:<service> tags and JSON content.
The projector publishes kind 30352 append-only degraded/emergency/offline activation events when the active profile changes away from full.
The projector publishes kind 30353 recovery progress read models by run with d=recovery-progress:<service>:<runID> and deterministic step tags.
Kind 30351 is republished only when active profile, operation state, active worker, run ID, or the current step tuple changes; failed publishes are not cached as successful publication state.
